metadata.title: Wedge's Trial
metadata.description: Logic puzzle game inspired by Gothic Remake's lockpicking mechanics.

about.title: About Wedge's Trial
about.lead: Wedge's Trial is a browser lockpicking challenge built around deterministic pin dependencies and endless chest progression.
about.body: Each solved chest rewards ore nuggets and sometimes lockpicks, while every next lock adds a little more pressure through extra pins, denser dependencies, and longer generated solutions.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.lead: Select a pin, then move it left or right to line every pin up with its target position.
steps: Choose a pin by clicking it or using the keyboard shortcuts.
Move the selected pin left or right and watch for linked pins that shift with it.
Keep every affected pin inside its allowed range to avoid invalid moves.
Solve the current lock to open the chest, claim ore nuggets, and continue the endless run.
rules: A lockpick breaks after exactly 3 invalid moves.
Invalid moves do not change any pin positions.
Breaking a lockpick does not reset the current lock.
Use the reset button when you want to restart the current lock from its initial state.

solver.title: Solver
solver.lead: The generator mixes each lock from a solved state, so every chest stays solvable by construction.
solver.body: That same deterministic model powers the solver and the debug harness used to inspect dependencies, verify solutions, and test invalid-move behavior.

labels.keyboardMoveLeft: `A` or `ArrowLeft` moves the selected pin left
labels.keyboardMoveRight: `D` or `ArrowRight` moves the selected pin right
labels.moveHint: Pick a pin and move it directly

messages.active: Use the text controls to inspect dependencies, verify valid moves, and reproduce invalid move damage.
messages.failed: Run failed. No lockpicks remain, so lock interaction is blocked until a new run starts.
messages.idle: Start a run to inspect the generated lock and test move behavior.
messages.invalid: Invalid moves leave every pin in place and only damage the current lockpick.
messages.saved: A previously saved run is available from the last opened chest.
messages.solved: Lock solved. Advance to the next chest to generate a harder test lock and save the run.

debug.subtitle: Text-first browser harness for validating lock generation, move rules, invalid move damage, and manual reset behavior.
